relevance_note: Case series of six NOD2-mutation carriers with Blau syndrome, each with own Table 1 column (e.g. 'R587C and R471C'): "we report a series of 6 patients (3 men and 3 women) with Blau syndrome".
method_note: Read the whole Markdown by hand; a short Python script transcribed Table 1 row segments (patients as columns; data columns 1-6 = Case 1-Case 6, whose header labels are split across the lines 'Characteristics Case 1', 'Case 2', ... 'Case 6') and assembled the JSON; every transcribed cell was checked against the table. Table 1 is badly converted: row labels are merged and values are shifted by one row. Used only rows whose alignment is corroborated: sex (row 'Age, yrs Sex'; the age there is age at start of biologic therapy, not recorded as last evaluation), age at onset (row labelled 'Age at disease onset, yrs Disease duration, yrs'; the next row, labelled 'NOD2 mutations', holds the disease durations, and the unlabelled row after it holds the NOD2 variants; the text medians 1.7 (0.5-4.5) onset and 13.4 (0.8-18.1) duration match this reading), No. per site, Affected joint(s), uveitis Main findings, Rash, Lesion. Not used: the Medication MTX/PSL rows, the Uveitis row values (4, -, -, 2) and the Laboratory/ESR/CRP/MMP-3 rows, which are misaligned (e.g. '17.6 297' merged in one cell; Case 1's 'EN' slid into the Main findings cell). Uveitis onset ages taken only for Cases 1 and 2 from the 'Age at onset, yrs' row under Uveitis. Table 2 (rows 1-6-2) summary column is also shifted: 'Discontinuation due to an exacerbation of arthritis.' sits in row 4 but belongs with 5-1, and 'Discontinuation due to development of anti-TCZ IgE antibodies.' sits in row 5-3 but belongs with 6-1 (the text confirms both); these phrases were not attributed by row position. Case 3 uveitis recorded observed from 'Inactive' (Main findings) and 'no recurrence in uveitis'; Case 3 Rash 'None' recorded as rash excluded. Retinal vasculitis (Cases 2, 6) recorded as a feature but not as the checklist vasculitis item (which names large-vessel/leukocytoclastic types). Erythema nodosum filled the skin-rash checklist item only where the Table 1 Rash row prints EN (Cases 2, 6). Elevated ESR at last visit from Appendix 1 text naming patients 4 to 6; ESR at last visit for patients 1-3 not treated as excluded (baseline values unreadable). Group statement 'No patient had achieved clinical remission with prior treatments, including ... systemic corticosteroids' conflicts with 'cases 4 and 5 had never received systemic corticosteroids previously'; prior treatments therefore not put in treatment summaries. Variants are one-letter protein strings without zygosity, type or inheritance. Previously published people in the Discussion with individual-level facts were added: Otsubo et al. (ref 10) Japanese mother and daughter, and the pediatric patient with ETN-induced myelopathy (ref 9); refs 1, 4, 7, 8 describe groups only. First author taken from the first name in the printed author list (Nagakura); not printed as a byline.
